policy.strict_backtest: Only sources with causal timestamps plus tape/full-depth evidence sufficient to grade fills may contribute executable PnL.
policy.signal_robustness: Snapshot-only or proxy-fill sources may validate signal direction but may not contribute strict executable PnL.
policy.future_leak_gate: Every feature observation timestamp must be <= decision timestamp. Settlement/outcome fields are forbidden from features, sizing, filtering, fitting, scaling, early stopping, and policy selection.
policy.execution_grading: Post-decision observations may be used only to grade whether an already-fixed order would have filled; they may never alter the signal, side, price, size, or eligibility decided at decision time.
policy.oracle_rule: BTC Up/Down settlement is defined by the market resolution oracle. Binance may be used for fast spot/RV anchoring, but oracle-basis experiments must preserve a Chainlink-consistent strike/underlying pair and remain causal.

kinzikdza_pm_microstructure.notes: Existing frozen Main Sequence corpus. Earlier collection is excluded from strict results because of known resolution contamination.

solal_crypto_updown.notes: Actual BTC15m snapshot coverage audited as 2026-03-14 through 2026-04-25. Snapshot/orderbook source; resolution fields are never decision features.

obadiaha_crypto_5m_15m.notes: Dense March Data API trade tape is retained as independent execution witness and resolution source. The approximately 10-second /book snapshots are not accepted as primary quote truth after cross-source audit: versus real tape, median causal lag was about 5.36s and median absolute price gap about 35.1c, with only about 14.4% within 5c.

arena_capture.notes: Native book/trade capture has asset_id plus explicit Up/Down outcome and is a strong later-period execution cross-check.

vinayak_orderbooks.notes: Snapshot/proxy execution only. Never report its proxy fills as strict executable PnL.

openmarket_unified.notes: Archived v0.4.3-unified / source tag v0.5.2. Cross-source audit against independent real tape found 31,088 causal matches, median quote-to-trade lag about 4ms, median absolute price gap about 1c, and about 93.1% within 5c. Use as primary PM quote/depth and synchronized Binance-tick layer. Known unrecoverable 2026-04-22 through 2026-05-12 gap. Executable fills still require independent post-decision tape corroboration.

trent_crypto_derivatives.notes: Immutable revision audited in CI. BTC15m episodes are approximately 100ms decision snapshots. steps.parquet contains causal chainlink_price and binance_price plus UP/DOWN BBO/depth summaries; events.parquet contains CLOB events/trades; book_levels.parquet contains normalized full depth. Use for predeclared same-threshold Binance-vs-Chainlink oracle-basis comparisons and, after execution semantics are validated, model features.

krish_v1_onchain_fills.notes: Pinned v1 OrderFilled ground truth, BTC15m coverage 2026-03-01 through 2026-04-28. Download only candidate windows. Metadata may map token IDs before trading; any post-close resolution fields are forbidden from signal construction.

brockmisner_crypto_derivatives.notes: Large historical archive pinned before use. Inspect manifest and small slices before materializing the full corpus.
